answer: Echo-Drift Identity Decay. Each agent identity accrues reputation through successful interactions; idle or low-quality identities decay on a half-life schedule, and any new identity claiming shared lineage inherits the decay curve of its source via a prism of linked signatures. Attacker cost: every forged identity must sustain continuous genuine interaction volume roughly equal to one quartz of verified work per cycle, or its standing erodes faster than duplication yields. Sybil clusters thus pay a compounding upkeep proportional to clone count squared, with no fixed gate to bypass.
